purpose: Per-item assessment planning; neither implementation qualification nor a target security verdict.

source.interpretation: Original English operational requirements mapped to the 36 checklist items. Other service sections have separate scope.

capabilities.limit: Scoped records and reviewer judgments; no autonomous execution or general assessment verdict.
Six finite lead families plus attributed reasoning; no whole-program detection guarantee.
Finite declared Python response/state models, not actual databases or deployed protection.
Exact authorized GET/HEAD, response predicates and same-resource role comparisons; no browser, login automation or target mutation.
Finite configuration leads and selected local container observations, not remote account or network qualification.
Current reviewed release-embedded secret/configuration rules only; no vulnerability database or complete dependency inventory.
Bounded read workloads; no business writes, general rate-limit correctness or resource-saturation proof.
Selected standalone SQLite artifacts and disposable restores; no whole-service recovery or proven RPO.
Private evidence custody and limited receiver acknowledgments; no target log pipeline, containment or recurring monitoring.

controls.title: Identify protected assets and trust crossings
required_evidence: A scoped asset, actor and data-flow inventory corroborated with source/configuration locations.
controls.acceptance: Every selected sensitive flow names its owner, readers, writers and trust boundary; unavailable surfaces remain explicit.
controls.legitimate_test: Trace an intended user operation across its authorized components.
controls.prohibited_test: Find an undocumented sensitive transfer or privilege crossing and keep that gap visible.
controls.remaining_gap: No automatic complete architecture discovery or proof of the actual deployed topology.

controls.title: Derive system-specific abuse scenarios
required_evidence: Threat scenarios tied to concrete entrypoints, attacker capabilities and affected assets.
controls.acceptance: Each selected boundary has plausible abuse cases, prerequisites and counterevidence rather than a generic vulnerability list.
controls.legitimate_test: Retain the permitted actor's intended flow in every relevant scenario.
controls.prohibited_test: Do not mark an unexamined entrypoint covered because another route was reviewed.
controls.remaining_gap: Threat completeness and prioritization require project-specific reasoning and review.

controls.title: Evaluate prevention and impact-limiting controls
required_evidence: A control-to-threat mapping with actual source/configuration and relevant observed behavior.
controls.acceptance: Explain what each control prevents, residual exposure and evidence limitations; a missing secondary defense alone is not a confirmed exploit.
controls.legitimate_test: Show that the intended business operation remains available with the control enabled.
controls.prohibited_test: Reject a control-success claim supported only by a policy statement or self-reported passed flag.
controls.remaining_gap: The model probe cannot prove deployed or persistent-state protection.

controls.title: Review account creation, recovery and stronger authentication
required_evidence: Source/configuration traces and isolated account-lifecycle tests, including registration, login, recovery, password changes and MFA where applicable.
controls.acceptance: Account changes require the intended identity and cannot bypass stronger authentication or account ownership.
controls.legitimate_test: A synthetic owner completes the configured login and recovery flows.
controls.prohibited_test: An unrelated account or reused recovery challenge cannot take over the synthetic account.
controls.remaining_gap: No generic login, recovery or MFA execution adapter.

controls.title: Verify the complete session and token lifecycle
required_evidence: Session creation/storage configuration and observations before and after expiry, logout, credential reset and privilege changes.
controls.acceptance: Issued credentials have appropriate scope and lifetime, and required invalidation is effective on the server.
controls.legitimate_test: A current authorized session accesses its own selected resource.
controls.prohibited_test: An expired, logged-out or revoked credential cannot retain the protected access.
controls.remaining_gap: Cookie leads and exact reads do not execute or verify the complete lifecycle.

controls.title: Check account-abuse resistance
required_evidence: Authentication throttling and sensitive-account policy plus bounded multi-instance tests with synthetic accounts.
controls.acceptance: Failed attempts and account-discovery behavior meet the declared policy without exposing account details or creating an unintended account lockout path.
controls.legitimate_test: A permitted owner can still authenticate within the accepted workload.
controls.prohibited_test: Distributing attempts across processes must not multiply the configured account limit.
controls.remaining_gap: The auditor's own request budget is not proof of target authentication throttling.

controls.title: Check operation, object, file and field permissions
required_evidence: A resource/operation/field permission matrix and positive/denied observations for the same protected object.
controls.acceptance: Every selected access path enforces server-side permission; denied writes leave protected state unchanged.
controls.legitimate_test: The authorized owner can read or change only the allowed fields and operations.
controls.prohibited_test: A denied role cannot obtain the object through an alternate method, export, file or field.
controls.remaining_gap: Actual write effects and all alternate endpoints require a project-specific runtime harness.

controls.title: Verify isolation between customers and organizations
required_evidence: Distinct synthetic tenants and identities, same-resource comparisons and independent persisted-state evidence where writes are involved.
controls.acceptance: Changing object or tenant selectors never exposes or changes another customer's selected records.
controls.legitimate_test: Each tenant can access its own synthetic record with a distinct credential.
controls.prohibited_test: Cross-tenant identifiers, bulk operations and alternate lookup paths cannot cross the ownership boundary.
controls.remaining_gap: Current hash-based comparisons do not establish semantic isolation of dynamic responses or deployed databases.

controls.title: Check privileged and service identities
required_evidence: Actual administrative/service identity inventory, effective permissions and lifecycle observations.
controls.acceptance: Privileges are limited to justified actions and resources, and removed accounts lose the selected access.
controls.legitimate_test: A scoped service credential performs its intended operation.
controls.prohibited_test: The same credential cannot perform an unrelated administrative operation or access another environment.
controls.remaining_gap: Finite IAM declarations do not prove effective remote permissions or account revocation.

controls.title: Verify protection in storage and transport
required_evidence: Sensitive-store inventory, encryption/key configuration and observations of the selected transport/storage boundary.
controls.acceptance: Protection matches the data and threat model, including password hashing; successful HTTPS alone does not qualify storage encryption.
controls.legitimate_test: An authorized application can read its protected data using the intended key access.
controls.prohibited_test: A lower-privilege principal cannot obtain plaintext through an exposed store, backup or transport path.
controls.remaining_gap: No complete cryptographic, TLS-configuration or storage-encryption assessment adapter.

controls.title: Verify secret access, rotation and revocation
required_evidence: Secret locations and readers, scoped access configuration and synthetic rotation/revocation observations.
controls.acceptance: Secrets remain outside unintended code/log outputs, and revoked credentials stop working while replacement credentials retain intended access.
controls.legitimate_test: The replacement synthetic credential works after the controlled transition.
controls.prohibited_test: The revoked credential fails; deleting a string from source does not count as revocation.
controls.remaining_gap: No provider-specific rotation executor or complete repository-history scanner.

controls.title: Verify collection, sharing, retention and deletion
required_evidence: Field-purpose/retention inventory and synthetic lifecycle observations across primary and downstream copies.
controls.acceptance: Collection and sharing have a stated purpose, and the declared retention/deletion policy covers caches, exports, queues, backups and third parties.
controls.legitimate_test: The owner can use and export permitted data before its policy-driven deletion.
controls.prohibited_test: After deletion, forbidden copies cannot be retrieved through alternate stores or accounts.
controls.remaining_gap: No end-to-end data-copy or deletion verification adapter; no legal compliance conclusion.

controls.title: Trace untrusted data to dangerous effects
required_evidence: Source-to-sink traces, relevant parser/framework configuration, counterevidence and bounded reproduction when needed.
controls.acceptance: Selected input reaches only intended query, command, template and output semantics; syntax leads remain unconfirmed until validated.
controls.legitimate_test: Valid boundary inputs retain intended query and rendering behavior.
controls.prohibited_test: A malicious input cannot introduce a new command, query operation or executable output.
controls.remaining_gap: Six finite rule families do not provide interprocedural or framework-wide analysis.

controls.title: Verify upload, processing and download boundaries
required_evidence: File lifecycle traces and isolated tests of content, size, path, execution and ownership restrictions.
controls.acceptance: Only permitted content and operations reach owned storage; uploaded files cannot become executable code or bypass download authorization.
controls.legitimate_test: An allowed synthetic file can be uploaded, processed and downloaded by its owner.
controls.prohibited_test: A disallowed file, traversal path or other user's file reference is refused without an unintended file effect.
controls.remaining_gap: No generic file-upload or server-side-fetch execution adapter.

controls.title: Verify browser trust, request intent and safe errors
required_evidence: Browser/header configuration, cross-origin/request-intent tests and complete sanitized error observations.
controls.acceptance: Selected browser interactions enforce the intended origins and request intent; errors expose no protected details.
controls.legitimate_test: An approved origin and valid user action retain the intended browser flow.
controls.prohibited_test: A foreign origin, forged request intent or malformed input cannot expose data or perform a protected action.
controls.remaining_gap: Header-presence flags do not prove effective CSP, CORS, CSRF or browser behavior.

controls.title: Enforce ordered sensitive workflows
required_evidence: An independently specified state-transition model, required approvals and observed intermediate/final state.
controls.acceptance: Sensitive transitions require their prerequisites and actor authority on every path.
controls.legitimate_test: The authorized user completes the normal ordered flow.
controls.prohibited_test: Skipping, reordering or replaying a step cannot reach an unauthorized final state.
controls.remaining_gap: Serialized model results do not prove real service or database transitions.

controls.title: Protect amounts, quantities and quotas
required_evidence: Server-side business invariants, boundary cases and independent protected-state observations.
controls.acceptance: The server derives or validates authoritative amounts and limits, including negative, extreme and conflicting values.
controls.legitimate_test: A valid transaction at the allowed boundary succeeds with the expected amount and inventory.
controls.prohibited_test: Client-supplied prices, negative quantities or alternate routes cannot exceed the approved entitlement.
controls.remaining_gap: No general payment, inventory or quota test harness.

controls.title: Prevent duplicate and concurrent state violations
required_evidence: Idempotency and transaction contracts, bounded concurrent synthetic writes and independently captured resulting state.
controls.acceptance: Retries and competing operations preserve the stated balance, uniqueness and ownership invariants.
controls.legitimate_test: Distinct valid transactions remain available and produce distinct durable results.
controls.prohibited_test: Duplicate callbacks or concurrent requests cannot apply the same effect twice or corrupt state.
controls.remaining_gap: Read-load generation and detached SQLite checks are not an end-to-end write/concurrency test.

controls.title: Inventory exposed API versions and privileged routes
required_evidence: Corroborated route/version inventory covering selected application, proxy and deployed configuration.
controls.acceptance: Supported, legacy, test and administrative entrypoints each have an owner, intended exposure and reviewed access boundary.
controls.legitimate_test: The supported client reaches the intended version and operation.
controls.prohibited_test: A forgotten or alternate endpoint cannot bypass the selected access control.
controls.remaining_gap: No comprehensive runtime crawler or automatic route/version inventory.

controls.title: Validate external responses and inbound message authenticity
required_evidence: Integration contracts, signature/canonicalization rules and synthetic valid, forged and malformed messages.
controls.acceptance: External content is validated as untrusted data and privileged incoming messages require the correct issuer and signature.
controls.legitimate_test: A correctly signed message and valid provider response complete the intended operation.
controls.prohibited_test: An altered body, wrong signer or malformed provider response cannot perform the protected transition.
controls.remaining_gap: No provider-specific webhook/signature or response-validation runtime adapter.

controls.title: Check API consumption limits and replay controls
required_evidence: Target rate/resource policy, message freshness/idempotency rules and bounded multi-instance observations.
controls.acceptance: The target enforces the declared aggregate consumption and replay policy without confusing request rejection with successful business throughput.
controls.legitimate_test: A fresh allowed request within budget succeeds.
controls.prohibited_test: An old signed message or distributed excess request cannot bypass the target's declared policy.
controls.remaining_gap: Auditor admission limits do not validate target replay defense, resource cost or distributed throttling.

controls.title: Identify vulnerable, unsupported or untrusted components
required_evidence: Exact selected dependency inventory, actual shipped/build context and freshly acquired authoritative advisory/maintenance information.
controls.acceptance: Every selected supported component has an attributed lookup; unsupported ecosystems, missing versions and stale data cannot become a clean result.
controls.legitimate_test: A supported fixed-version fixture produces a complete nonmatching advisory result with its data identity.
controls.prohibited_test: A vulnerable, stale-feed or omitted-component fixture cannot be reported as fully checked and clean.
controls.remaining_gap: No automatic current vulnerability-feed adapter or complete shipped-component inventory.

controls.title: Verify package integrity and publisher/build provenance
required_evidence: Artifact digest, trusted publisher identity and verified signatures or applicable provenance tied to the selected build.
controls.acceptance: Expected publisher/build inputs match the artifact; a checksum alone proves neither publisher authenticity nor source-to-build provenance.
controls.legitimate_test: A valid artifact from the approved publisher verifies against the intended identity policy.
controls.prohibited_test: A changed artifact or valid signature from an unapproved identity is refused.
controls.remaining_gap: M1/M6 protect the assessor's own components; target artifact attestation and build provenance need a separate adapter.

controls.title: Review build permissions, isolation and approval controls
required_evidence: Pipeline source and effective repository/environment permissions, secret paths, runner isolation and approval observations.
controls.acceptance: Untrusted changes cannot access privileged build/deploy credentials or publish an unapproved artifact.
controls.legitimate_test: An approved change passes required checks and reaches only its permitted release stage.
controls.prohibited_test: An untrusted pull request or failed required gate cannot obtain secrets or release authority.
controls.remaining_gap: Lexical workflow leads do not observe hosted settings, effective permissions or runner behavior.

controls.title: Inspect selected platform security configuration
required_evidence: Version-matched operating-system, web-server, database, cloud and container configuration for the explicitly selected components.
controls.acceptance: Applicable controls are evaluated against actual configuration and ownership; inaccessible providers stay unverified.
controls.legitimate_test: Required service functions continue under the proposed least-privilege settings.
controls.prohibited_test: A dangerous default, privileged container or public private-data store produces an actionable lead rather than an ignored exception.
controls.remaining_gap: Finite local configuration rules do not establish effective remote platform posture.

controls.title: Check exposed services, defaults and debugging surfaces
required_evidence: Authorized exposure inventory and observations of selected listeners, administrative/debug routes and default settings.
controls.acceptance: Only justified services and routes are exposed; external observation is distinguished from declarations.
controls.legitimate_test: The required public service remains reachable from the intended client location.
controls.prohibited_test: An unauthorized location cannot reach a private management/debug service or backup file.
controls.remaining_gap: No network-port discovery or general administrative-route enumeration adapter.

controls.title: Verify environment and administrative-network separation
required_evidence: Effective network/identity rules and observations from each agreed source environment and role.
controls.acceptance: Development, staging and production communications and administrative access follow the approved boundaries.
controls.legitimate_test: The authorized service and management paths work from their intended locations.
controls.prohibited_test: A lower-trust environment or role cannot reach production data or management interfaces.
controls.remaining_gap: No remote segmentation or effective cloud-permission collector.

controls.title: Verify useful and protected security-event logging
required_evidence: Event requirements, synthetic sensitive operations and correlated target log records with access and retention controls.
controls.acceptance: Selected actions are attributable without leaking protected values, and unauthorized modification or deletion is prevented or detected.
controls.legitimate_test: A synthetic privileged action generates the expected protected audit event.
controls.prohibited_test: An unauthorized actor cannot erase the event or cause secrets to appear in public logs.
controls.remaining_gap: The assessor's own evidence ledger does not verify the application's log pipeline.

controls.title: Test the security-alert ownership and escalation path
required_evidence: An owned detection scenario, target event, alert, actual receiver acknowledgment and responsible escalation role.
controls.acceptance: The correlated alert reaches the intended recipient within the agreed window; missing hops stay explicit.
controls.legitimate_test: A representative synthetic event reaches the responsible receiver with usable context.
controls.prohibited_test: An unrelated, old or missing acknowledgment cannot satisfy delivery acceptance.
controls.remaining_gap: Existing challenge acknowledgments do not prove all detection and notification transports.

controls.title: Exercise incident decision and response procedures
required_evidence: An approved response plan, roles, authority boundaries and an observed tabletop or disposable-environment exercise.
controls.acceptance: Detection, escalation, containment and recovery decisions have owners, stop conditions and preserved evidence.
controls.legitimate_test: The responsible operator follows the approved scenario and records decisions and handoffs.
controls.prohibited_test: Untrusted incident text or an unapproved role cannot trigger containment, cleanup or external notification.
controls.remaining_gap: No automatic containment, notification sending or whole-service incident-response execution.

controls.title: Verify backup confidentiality and resistance to tampering
required_evidence: Backup storage/key/access configuration and synthetic read, deletion and integrity checks under distinct roles.
controls.acceptance: Required backup copies remain confidential, independently protected and recoverable under the stated compromise scenario.
controls.legitimate_test: The recovery operator can access a consistent usable backup through the approved path.
controls.prohibited_test: A compromised application identity cannot read or destroy all protected backup copies.
controls.remaining_gap: SQLite integrity does not prove encryption, object immutability, off-site separation or backup account independence.

controls.title: Measure representative restoration against recovery goals
required_evidence: Consistent representative backups, independently established snapshot times and observed restored-service usability with data checks.
controls.acceptance: The agreed service-time and data-loss objectives are met using actual observations, not declared dates or file presence alone.
controls.legitimate_test: Restore representative disposable data and confirm the application's intended read/write workflow.
controls.prohibited_test: An unreadable, inconsistent or incomplete restore cannot pass because a backup file exists.
controls.remaining_gap: Current small SQLite restores do not prove service RTO, actual RPO or other database engines.

controls.title: Exercise recovery responsibilities after a security incident
required_evidence: A recovery runbook, trusted rebuild/source selection, credential decisions, responsible roles and a representative exercise.
controls.acceptance: Recovery preserves required evidence, closes the selected incident path and verifies readiness before returning the service.
controls.legitimate_test: Named operators restore the agreed disposable service and complete the handoff checks.
controls.prohibited_test: Restoring a compromised artifact or retaining revoked access cannot satisfy security recovery.
controls.remaining_gap: No automatic rebuild, deployed rollback, credential rotation or service cutover adapter.

controls.title: Run only scoped, supported assessment methods
required_evidence: Explicit asset/effect scope, current accepted tool/data identities and actual execution records for each selected method.
controls.acceptance: Executed and unsupported surfaces are separate; scanner success and zero findings never imply universal safety.
controls.legitimate_test: A current supported adapter completes the authorized bounded fixture with attributed output.
controls.prohibited_test: A stale tool, unauthorized destination or unavailable scanner cannot be replaced with an unbounded host command.
controls.remaining_gap: General dynamic scans and several candidate adapters are not connected.

controls.title: Validate findings and retain counterevidence
required_evidence: Concrete source/runtime paths, impact, counterevidence and reviewer decisions bound to the exact selected revision.
controls.acceptance: Confirmed, unresolved and refuted findings remain distinct; stale support retracts conclusions and incomplete fixes fail retesting.
controls.legitimate_test: A safe near-match remains usable and is rejected as a vulnerability with supporting counterevidence.
controls.prohibited_test: A superficial patch or changed supporting source cannot retain an earlier verified-fix claim.
controls.remaining_gap: Review correctness and detection quality still need broader held-out application cases.

controls.title: Map each selected obligation to evidence and an explicit outcome
required_evidence: An applicable versioned requirement or project policy, per-item evidence, reviewer rationale and separately recorded target result.
controls.acceptance: Every selected item is reviewed, blocked, not applicable with evidence, or unverified; a completed checklist is not certification.
controls.legitimate_test: A supported control retains its scoped evidence and explicit residual limitations.
controls.prohibited_test: Missing access, a blank row, a broad chapter reference or a planned adapter cannot become a passing control.
controls.remaining_gap: Existing M2 templates are broad; standards require requirement-level mapping and evidence beyond this planning catalog.
